r60_settled.turnover_ceiling_defect: The scalar 0.40 one-way ceiling is TWO different economic constraints and misspecified as one. Measured: the equity H5 cell at 0.870 turnover and 25bp/side costs 21.9%/yr and is genuinely inexpressible; the two futures cells at ~0.60 turnover and 5bp/side cost only 0.72%/yr and were killed by a ceiling calibrated for equities. That destroyed two of four non-equity cells before any return was scored. The halts STAND (they were pre-registered); the replacement is a per-cell NET COST BUDGET (turnover x cost/side x 2 x rebalances/yr), to be fixed campaign-wide and pinned by a test BEFORE any cell registers under it, so no ceiling is chosen after a turnover is seen.
r60_settled.substrate_state: us_equity_extension_pit_panel_v1 is RETAINED but FROZEN PENDING AUDIT. Not falsified - none of the three deaths on it is attributable to the panel. But its identity bridge resolves delisted names by ISSUER NAME and is unaudited, and a RATIO feature converts a mis-match into a rank EXTREME, so a bottom-100 book selects TOWARD mis-bridged names. Until audited, success on it is uninterpretable and failure uninformative.
r60_settled.identity_bridge_audit_must_establish: false-match rate against a permanent identifier (CUSIP/PERMNO/FIGI) with a CI; whether the 9.2% unbridged delisted attrition is conditionally ignorable by termination reason; extreme-decile contamination by low-confidence bridges; PIT separation of splits and stock-financed M&A from economic issuance; characterisation of sign/units/attribution errors that SURVIVE the non-positive filter; real delisting returns rather than truncation; a versioned hashed bridge artifact; pre-registered pass/fail thresholds.
r60_settled.open_reporting_defect: max_drawdown is written as 0.0000 on the excess-return series in the cell artifacts while the skeptic's bundle carries plausible values (strat -0.1791 / -0.3973 / -0.2042). NOT blocking at discovery because no gate reads drawdown; BLOCKING the moment a candidate reaches the risk agent.

best_domains.best_unexplored_futures_domain: The R38 native DATED-CONTRACT layer beyond slope level: 12 hypotheses against 5846 on the back-adjusted panel. Basis-momentum and exchange open-interest dynamics need the deferred contract and real OI, which only this layer has.
best_domains.best_h1_h5_domain: H1-H5 is 0.45% of the estate (38 tests). Equity H1-H5 on PRICE ALONE in the S&P 500 is closed, and futures intraday is closed. What is open is H1-H5 liquidity-provision reversal on the extension universe with an executable next-open entry, and H1-H5 reversal conditioned on never-used non-price information (FINRA short-volume share). Turnover, not signal, is the binding constraint.

R68_CENSUS_CORRECTION.nothing_was_deleted: Every original claim, including the false ones, is left in place beside its correction. An append-only correction is the estate's pattern; a rewritten claim teaches nobody anything.
R68_CENSUS_CORRECTION.honest_reading: All five top-ranked proposals carry settled rows on the key checked, but they are NOT five instances of one error. Two (ranks 1 and 4) are outright false novelty claims on the exact mechanism key. Two (ranks 2 and 5) are sample replications whose mechanism is settled and whose budgeting was wrong rather than whose claim was false. One (rank 3) was checked on a COARSER key than the rest and its mechanism is NOT established as settled. Reporting all five as the same failure would be the same kind of overstatement this correction exists to remove.
